page.subtitle: the visuals that render the instrument's output — one grammar, many forms, each gated
page.reads: The right-side companion to the method engine. The method engine breaks a text into moves and wires them; THIS engine renders that finalized output into figures for two audiences, composing into a reading room. Each visual is a node with a spec-drawer (what it shows, which method node + feed it reads, its encoding, its four-check gate). The grammar every node obeys, and the gate every node passes, live on the design principles page. Validated by 3DR-16.

seam: This engine's INPUT is the method's FINALIZED feeds (Text=checkout.json · Decompose=moves.json · Connect=connect_node_drawer.json); the TRANSFORMATION is design-SB's. A node reads_from a feed field — it never re-authors a method fact (that was the Connect-status bug). Un-finalized engines (Situate / Frame / Gloss) are out of scope until finalized.

nodes.name: The Move Score
nodes.one_line: the passage read move by move, each move aligned to the words it covers
nodes.encoding: Read (default): verbatim verse is the foreground reading text; each move is a secondary 'reading' note beneath (serif, lighter, M-label + 'see how' affordance). Reveal = a labeled line (who/does/on/result) with the chip-diagram optional; decoded keyed axes (kind of move / agent's role: Acts·Undergoes·A state / place) — plain word first, code term demoted; narrator shown. Nesting SHOWN + demarked (recursive, accumulating indent) — never collapsed. The 16:8 textual-variant apparatus kept in Read; 16:9–20 rendered as the visibly-ADDED longer ending; the 16:8 silence as an empty-outcome slot. Focus = scroll-driven cadence (nearest move lights). Distant = the arc (moves-per-verse). Read|Inspect toggle with preserved selection. Zero-token annotation trace (highlight+note+save, W3C-quote anchor). v1 aligns at VERSE grain; exact move→char-span highlighting is the fidelity ceiling, pending a span map (method roadmap).

nodes.name: The Ledger of Absences

nodes.encoding: a positive mark for a negative result: ○ = tested-and-absent, · = not assessed, — = not applicable.
